cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
description: We offer daily paddle tours of Glorietta bay, the San Diego-Coronado bay bridge and America’s finest City.
what_is_included: Tours depart at 9am and take approximately 90 minutes with at least 60 minutes on the bay. Tours are limited to 10 participants and guide(s) will accompany you along the route.
